name: Canine Survival
description: Survival played as a dog, in a place the people have left. The nose is the main instrument: scent is information with age and direction, moved by wind and washed by rain. One thing is carried at a time, in the mouth, and a heavy thing is dragged; a den is dug and rested in and hides what the mouth brought. The body is shaped by what it does, under a budget, so every gain is paid for. The pack's own pieces are the field, the mouth, the den and the body; the land, the day and the weather are the survival pack's. What wakes when a thing has been carried long enough is the next pack.
loop: sniff → carry → dig in → rest → carry on

signatureCompound.name: The Leash and the Blanket
signatureCompound.description: A dog in a yard at dusk: the owner's scent a day old on the step, a leash by the gate that smells of her, a blanket on the line too heavy to lift. Carry the leash along the remembered route; drag the blanket under the stairs; dig in and rest through the first thunder. The compound proves the causal chain: scent leads to the thing, carrying costs the mouth and shapes the body, the den turns an expedition into a night survived.
